<title level="1" right="Class Feature 15">[Legendary Overdrive](/Classes.aspx?ID=19)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 15

**Class** Inventor
</column>

---

Your peerless inventing and [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) ability has supercharged your Overdrives. You become legendary in Crafting, and on a successful Overdrive, you increase the additional damage by a total of 3, replacing the increase from master overdrive.
name: Legendary Overdrive
